description: In a <<- heredoc, stripping a line's indentation makes it count as unindented
notes: The spec says <<- removes the smallest number of leading spaces from all line-leading literals, and that strip markers remove adjacent spaces, without saying which happens first. Removing indentation first gives "b\na\n", since the marker then has no spaces left to strip. hashicorp/hcl strips first, in parseTemplateParts (hclsyntax/parser_template.go): the two spaces before ${~ become an empty line-leading literal, which flushHeredocTemplateParts counts as a line with no indentation, so it removes none.
